video.hdHelp: Uses more data. Turns off by itself when your connection is slow.
video.offOnJoin: Turn off my camera when I join
video.autoPipHelp: In Chrome, when you switch to another tab or app during a meeting, a small window keeps it in view

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.intro: {appName} follows your device for reduced motion, contrast and text size. These settings are for things your device can’t know.
accessibility.singleKeys: Single-key shortcuts (Space to talk, ? for shortcuts)
accessibility.singleKeysHelp: Turn this off if you use speech input or a switch device, so a single key never triggers an action by accident.
accessibility.noKeyboard: Keyboard shortcuts show up here when you use {appName} with a keyboard.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.unavailable: Each meeting’s page has buttons to add it to Google Calendar, Outlook or any calendar app.
calendar.connectTitle: Add meetings to your Google Calendar
calendar.connectBody: Connect once, and Google emails the people you invite. If you change or cancel a meeting, everyone’s calendar updates. {appName} only touches the events it makes.
calendar.alsoSignIn: Connecting also lets you sign in with that Google account.
calendar.connectedBody: When you schedule a meeting, leave “Add to my Google Calendar and send invitations” on. Google sends the invitations, and your changes reach everyone’s calendar.
calendar.reconnectBody: Google stopped {appName}’s access to your calendar. Until Google verifies {appName}’s calendar access, it asks again every 7 days. Your meetings are still saved here.
calendar.disconnectBody: Events already in your calendar stay there, but {appName} stops updating them. You can connect again any time.
calendar.disconnectFailed: Couldn’t disconnect Google Calendar. Try again.
calendar.otherCalendars: Each meeting’s page also has buttons to add it to Outlook or any calendar app.
calendar.popupConnected: Google Calendar is connected. You can close this window.
calendar.popupNotConnected: Google Calendar wasn’t connected. You can close this window and try again.

effects.title: Backgrounds and effects
effects.intro: The background or effect on your camera, in every meeting on this device. You can change it in a meeting too, from the camera menu.

aiNotes.title: AI notes
aiNotes.intro: AI notes write a summary, decisions and action items for meetings you host. Turn them on here, then start them in a meeting from More › AI notes. Everyone sees when they're on.
aiNotes.inMeetings: AI notes in meetings you host
aiNotes.inMeetingsHelp: You and your co-hosts can start them in a meeting. Each meeting starts with them off, and turning this off stops any that are on.
aiNotes.inMeetingsFailed: Couldn't change AI notes for your meetings. Try again.
aiNotes.onDeviceHelp: Free. Speech and summaries stay on each person's device. Needs a recent Chrome on a computer.
aiNotes.ownKeyHelp: Your AI provider writes the summary. They bill you, not {appName}.
aiNotes.modelHelp: Pick one, or type any model ID your provider offers.
aiNotes.keyStays: Your key stays in this browser. {appName} never stores it, and it goes only to your provider.
aiNotes.freeTiers: Free plans may use what you send to improve their products. Google's free Gemini plan does, for example. Check your provider's terms before using a free key for private meetings.

account.title: Account
account.shownWhenOff: Shown when your camera is off
account.credit: Avatars: Dylan by Natalia Spivak (CC BY 4.0), via DiceBear.
account.verified: Verified. Password reset emails go here.
account.notVerified: Not verified yet. Use the link we emailed you.
account.onlyMethod: Connected. Add another method before removing it.
account.removeFailed: Couldn’t remove that sign-in method. Try again.
account.removeSignInFirst: For your security, sign in again, then remove it.

linkErrors.emailMismatch: That account uses a different email. Connect one that uses {email}.
linkErrors.alreadyLinked: That account is already connected to a different {appName} account.
linkErrors.generic: Couldn’t connect that account. Try again.

account.passwordNotSet: Sign in with your email and a password, too.
account.passwordSet: Password set. Changing it signs you out on your other devices.
account.setPasswordHelp: Then you can also sign in with {email} and this password.
account.deleteBody: Deleting your account removes your meetings, notes and avatar for good. People you invited can no longer join your meetings.
account.deleteConfirmBody: This can’t be undone. Your meetings, notes and avatar are removed for good, and people you invited can no longer join your meetings.
account.deleteCalendar: Your upcoming meetings are also cancelled in your Google Calendar, and Google lets the people you invited know.
account.signInFirst: For your security, sign in again, then delete your account.
account.legal: The <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> explains what {appName} keeps about you and for how long, and the <terms>Terms</terms> cover using it.

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.showOthersHelp: When off, your own reactions still appear
reactions.soundHelp: A soft sound plays with each reaction
reactions.soundPaused: Paused while notifications are off (Settings → Notifications)
reactions.announceHelp: Only other people’s reactions are announced.

announceOptions.summary: A short summary, at most every 10 seconds

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: What gets your attention during a meeting. Reactions have their own section.
notifications.allHelp: Turn this off to pause them all, the reaction sound too. Your choices below stay for when it's back on, and screen readers still hear reactions as set in Reactions.

soundPeople.label: People joining and leaving
soundPeople.help: Including you, and when you're let in. In meetings of up to 8 people

soundHands.label: Raised hands
soundHands.help: When you're a host or co-host

soundLobby.label: Waiting room
soundLobby.help: When someone asks to join, if you're a host or co-host

popupChat.label: Chat messages
popupChat.help: A preview of each new message while Chat is closed

popupHands.label: Raised hands
popupHands.help: Who raised their hand, when you're a host or co-host

popupLobby.label: Waiting room
popupLobby.help: Who's asking to join, with Admit. Participants always lists them

reminders.title: Meeting reminders
reminders.label: Remind me before meetings
reminders.help: While {appName} is open in a tab, for meetings you host or are invited to. Calendar files you add get the same reminder.
reminders.askBody: To be reminded when {appName} isn’t the tab you’re in, let your browser show notifications.
reminders.blocked: Your browser blocks {appName}’s notifications, so reminders show only in {appName}’s tab. Allow them in the site settings (the icon in the address bar).
reminders.allowed: Reminders also show as notifications from your browser.
reminders.homeScreen: On iPhone and iPad, reminders can show as notifications once {appName} is on your Home Screen. <link>How to add it</link>

GoogleCalendar.add: Add to my Google Calendar and send invitations
GoogleCalendar.addHelp: Google sends the invitations. If you change or cancel the meeting, everyone’s calendar updates.
GoogleCalendar.connectHelp: Connect Google Calendar once, and Google emails the people you invite.
GoogleCalendar.suggestionHidden: Hidden. You can connect Google Calendar any time in Settings, under Calendar.
GoogleCalendar.reconnectHelp: Google stopped {appName}’s access to your calendar. Reconnect so {appName} can keep it up to date.
GoogleCalendar.onCalendarHelp: Saving updates it, and Google emails everyone invited.
GoogleCalendar.onCalendarNote: On your Google Calendar. Google emails updates to everyone invited.
GoogleCalendar.addedInvited: Added to your Google Calendar. Google emailed the invitation to {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}.
GoogleCalendar.addFailed: Couldn’t add it to Google Calendar. The meeting is saved, and the calendar links below still work.
GoogleCalendar.addReconnect: Reconnect Google Calendar to add it there and send the invitations. The meeting is saved.
GoogleCalendar.updateReconnect: Reconnect Google Calendar to update it

problems.emailMismatch: That Google account uses a different email. Connect the one that uses {email}.
problems.alreadyLinked: That Google account is connected to a different {appName} account.
problems.scope: Google Calendar wasn’t connected: {appName} needs permission to make events in your calendar. Try again and allow it.
problems.generic: Couldn’t connect Google Calendar. Try again.

consent.signUp: By creating an account, you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and acknowledge the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
consent.signIn: By continuing, you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and acknowledge the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
consent.join: By joining, you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and acknowledge the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

Reminders.startsSoon: {title} starts in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}

Notes.title: AI notes
Notes.lineCount: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} in the transcript.
Notes.engineOnDevice: Notes are made on this computer, with Chrome's built-in AI.
Notes.engineOwnKey: Notes are made by {provider}, with your key.
Notes.firstDownload: Chrome downloads it the first time: a few gigabytes, which can take a while. Nothing downloads until you select Download and make notes.

notReady.noKey: Add your {provider} key in AI notes settings.
notReady.update: Chrome's built-in AI needs a newer Chrome. You can use your own AI key instead.
notReady.enable: Chrome's built-in AI is turned off in this browser. You can use your own AI key instead.
notReady.none: This browser doesn't have Chrome's built-in AI. You can use your own AI key instead.

failed.unreadable: The AI's answer couldn't be read as notes. Try again, or choose another model.
failed.onDevice: Chrome's built-in AI couldn't make the notes. Try again, or use your own AI key.
failed.noKey: Add your {provider} key in AI notes settings.
failed.limit: {provider} says you're over your limit or out of credit.

Notes.outdated: Made before the rest of the transcript. Select Make again to include it.
Notes.onlyYou: Only you can see these notes. Nothing is saved until you choose Save to meeting, and audio is never stored.
Notes.saveFailed: Couldn't save the notes. Try again.
Notes.savedPrivate: Saved with the meeting. Only you and the host can see them.
Notes.savedShared: Shared with the meeting's participants: everyone who was in it with an account can see them under Previous meetings.
Notes.transcriptLeftOut: The transcript was too long to save with them; Download keeps it.
Notes.onlyYouGuest: Only you can see these notes, in this tab. Audio is never stored. Copy or Download them to keep them.
Notes.autoShareNeedsAccount: This meeting shares AI notes with its participants, but saving them needs an account. Copy or Download them to share them yourself.

auto.label: Start AI notes automatically
auto.help: When you or a co-host joins. Everyone sees that AI notes are on, and anyone can choose not to be transcribed.

autoShare.label: Share AI notes with participants automatically
autoShare.help: As soon as they're made, they're saved with the meeting, and everyone who was in it with an account can see them under Previous meetings.

speech.ready: Ready. In meetings with AI notes on, what you say is turned into text on this device, so your voice never leaves it.
speech.needed: In meetings with AI notes on, what you say is turned into text on this device, so your voice never leaves it. This browser needs a one-time download for that first: a few hundred MB, which Chrome keeps.
speech.neededPreJoin: To put what you say in the notes, this browser needs a one-time download first: a few hundred MB, which Chrome keeps. Start it now and it can finish while you join.
speech.downloading: Downloading. You can carry on meanwhile.
speech.downloadingPreJoin: Downloading. You can join meanwhile: what you say goes into the notes once it's done.
speech.unavailable: This browser can't turn speech into text on your device, so what you say isn't in AI notes. Chrome on a computer can.
speech.failed: The download didn't finish. Try again.

SavedNotes.private: Only you and the host can see these notes. Audio is never stored.
SavedNotes.shared: Shared with the meeting's participants: everyone who was in it with an account can see them. Audio is never stored.
SavedNotes.sharedWithYou: Shared with the meeting's participants. Audio is never stored.
SavedNotes.nowShared: Notes shared with the meeting's participants
SavedNotes.failed: Couldn't change the notes. Try again.
SavedNotes.deleteConfirm: Delete these notes for everyone who can see them?
SavedNotes.showAll: Show all {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}

Effects.title: Backgrounds and effects
Effects.cameraOff: Turn on your camera to see your background.
Effects.addHelp: An image (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to {imageMegabytes} MB) or a looping video (MP4 or WebM, up to {videoSeconds} seconds and {videoMegabytes} MB). It stays in this browser.

rejected.type: That file isn’t an image or video {appName} can use.
rejected.tooLong: Videos can be up to {seconds} seconds long.

Effects.tooSlow: Effects were turned off to keep your video smooth.
Effects.failed: Your background couldn’t start, so your video is off.
Effects.previewFailed: That background couldn’t start on this device, so it’s off.
Effects.private: Everything happens on this device: nobody receives your video without the effect, and backgrounds you add never leave this browser.
Effects.unsupported: This browser can’t add backgrounds and effects. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

conference.spike: {appName} add-on test: this isn't a real meeting yet.

home.startHint: A new meeting with its own link, for now or later.
home.badMeetingId: A meeting ID is 10 digits, as in the invitation.
home.nothingNext: Nothing scheduled in the next week.

meeting.title: Your meeting
meeting.ready: Your meeting is ready. Join it now, or send the invitation.
meeting.invitationHint: Select the text to copy it.

signIn.title: Sign in to {appName}
signIn.body: {appName} doesn’t know this Google account yet. Sign in to {appName} with Google, then come back here.
signIn.emailBody: Connect Google Calendar in {appName}’s Settings, with this Google account.

errors.dailyLimit: You’ve made as many meetings as {appName} allows in a day. Try again tomorrow.
errors.unsupported: {appName} can’t follow this event’s repeat yet. Choose a simpler repeat, or add {appName} to one event.
errors.notAvailable: {appName} isn’t set up for Google Calendar and Gmail on this site.
